decision.reason: The original one-child SLR98 gate used utterance clips as frame-exact speech labels and applied one compiled calibration to both models; that rejection was invalid. With independent calibration and thresholds fixed on the general calibration split, v6.2.1 improves the general held-out set and a balanced external set of 44 children without an event or false-opening regression.

adapter_finding.shipped_behavior: AudioForge 1.9.0 sent 512 samples directly and looked for optional output state_n.
adapter_finding.documented_behavior: Silero v5.1.2 and v6.2.1 prepend 64 prior samples to each 512-sample frame and return recurrent output stateN.
adapter_finding.impact: The shipped adapter omitted documented context and silently left recurrent state at zero.
adapter_finding.fix: Send a fixed 576-sample tensor, require stateN with exactly 256 float elements, update context/state after successful inference, and reset both together.

corpus.speech: 54 FSDD v1.0.10 recordings, six speakers, CC BY-SA 4.0
corpus.noise: Six ESC-50 environmental recordings, CC BY-NC 3.0
corpus.split: Speaker-disjoint calibration, development, and held-out groups
corpus.label_method: Exact inserted-speech sample intervals; a model frame is positive at 50% or greater interval overlap.

downstream_constant_decisions.gate_default: Use 0.48, the UI-representable rounding of the independently selected v6 calibration threshold 0.475. Existing user-authored numeric thresholds are preserved.
downstream_constant_decisions.auto_setup_threshold: Replace the old 0.34-0.58 rule with a calibrated 0.4475-0.4725 SNR range.
downstream_constant_decisions.noise_floor_eligibility: Retain 0.30; it excludes speech-like clock transients while admitting the P99 of five of six noise-only classes.
downstream_constant_decisions.deesser_enable_probability: Unchanged because it is a sibilance-classifier probability, not a VAD posterior.

superseded_slr98_validation.validity_finding: Speaker b is correctly identified as the five-year-old child, but SLR98 supplies segmented utterance-level metadata rather than frame-exact speech intervals. Labeling every sample as speech made frame F1, recall, specificity, and onset unsuitable as a model-retention gate. Both models also shared the currently compiled calibration in each run.

general_corpus.interpretation: The final model-specific calibration leaves the general-corpus result mixed: v5 leads macro-F1 and balanced accuracy, while v6 has a small event-recall/onset advantage.

real_child_corpus.source: OpenSLR SLR98 Parent-Child Vocal Interaction, speaker-b child utterances, local evaluation only
real_child_corpus.superseded_report_status: Removed because its labels were invalid for frame-level and onset model selection.

superseded_slr98_validation.retention_rule: Superseded; these values are retained only to document why the first rejection was withdrawn.

corrected_model_selection.method: Fit a separate Platt transform and threshold for each model on the existing general calibration split; lock both; evaluate the general held-out split and an untouched OpenSLR SLR117 test subset balanced across ages 6-16 and female/male speakers; bootstrap paired differences by speaker.
corrected_model_selection.decision: Retain v6.2.1; every predefined independently calibrated general and multi-speaker child gate passes.

limitations: The local speech corpus contains English spoken digits from six speakers, not conversational multilingual speech.
The corrected child set contains Icelandic read speech from 44 speakers; spontaneous speech and children younger than six remain outside that external set.
SLR98 contains one five-year-old child and remains a qualitative stress corpus only; its old frame/onset metrics are not load-bearing.
High-pitch proxy results remain descriptive and are not treated as a substitute for real child speech.
Upstream v6.0/v6.2 quality claims remain author-reported; this report does not reproduce their private datasets.
Cold-start-inclusive corpus RTF includes one model/session construction per short capture and is not the live steady-state cost.
